calculation.first_byte: Median of five per-run means from dial start to first result byte. Not an individual request percentile.
calculation.limitation: Median paired change can differ from the ratio of median rates. No p95 or confidence interval is inferred from this small corpus.
calculation.paired_change: 100 * (candidate_rate / baseline_rate - 1) within each alternating pair; report median/range of five paired changes.
calculation.rate_MB_per_s: payload_bytes_per_stream * concurrency * 1000 / ns_per_op; decimal MB. Derived from ns/op to avoid displayed MB/s rounding.
calculation.rate_summary: Median and range of five process-level run means; each run mean covers five concurrent waves.

campaign.integrity: All 10 processes passed, all 12 cases per process present, N=5, source/binary hashes unchanged, raw log hashes verified, native descendant process groups gone.

environment.memory_peak_note: All memory.peak values are cumulative cgroup observations including the harness and 64 MiB corpus, not production Rabbit RSS. The peak was not reset between runs.

kelvo_acceptance.limitation: One ordered direct-then-Rabbit sample per query. Correctness proof only; race timings are not used for performance claims.

normal.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Debian 16.15-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
normal.scope: synthetic PostgreSQL fixture; native Kelvo CLI; verified source TLS; loopback direct versus Rabbit TLS tunnel

race.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Debian 16.15-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
race.scope: synthetic PostgreSQL fixture; native Kelvo CLI; verified source TLS; loopback direct versus Rabbit TLS tunnel

remaining_evidence_limits: WAN latency/loss and real private-host networks untested by this campaign
Separate final cleanup assertion validation is not part of the measured timing corpus
